title: Director, Global Delivery & Operations — IDC Site Lead
jobDescription:
Summary

The Director of Global Delivery & Operations is the senior-most IT leader at Fluke's India Development Center (IDC), responsible for end-to-end delivery execution, site operations, and workforce leadership across all technology domains. This role owns delivery outcomes across ERP, CRM, QA, Web, Digital Experience, BI & Analytics, AI Platforms, Security, Infrastructure, and AMS (BPO) — and serves as the primary execution hub connecting IDC with US, China, and EMEA teams. This is an ownership role — accountable for delivery performance, people leadership, budget and P&L, operational rigor, vendor execution, and cross-regional alignment.

Key Responsibilities

Delivery Ownership: Own execution, quality, and predictability of all IDC-delivered work across Oracle ERP, Fusion SaaS, MSD CRM, Web Applications, QA, Unified BI & Analytics, AI, Security, and Infrastructure — on time, on scope, with measurable business impact

Digital Experience & Platform Enablement: Own delivery of digital experience capabilities including Web Apps, Data & Reporting Enablement, Enterprise Data Platforms, AI Platforms & Tools CoE, and AI-Enabled Apps & Automation — ensuring IDC is a platform delivery engine, not a staff augmentation center

Site Leadership & People Management: Lead and develop a team of 25–30+ direct reports, owning performance management, career development, engagement, retention, and site culture

Talent Acquisition & Team Building: Build and scale the IDC team — own hiring strategy, capability planning, and talent pipeline development to close critical skill gaps across delivery tracks and position IDC as a destination for top engineering and delivery talent in Bangalore

Budget & P&L Ownership: Own the IDC site budget including headcount, vendor spend, infrastructure costs, and delivery economics. Drive cost discipline, track unit cost of delivery, and ensure financial transparency and accountability for all IDC operations

Cross-Regional Coordination: Serve as the execution hub across IDC, China, and EMEA enable follow-the-sun delivery, reduce handoffs, and enforce consistent engineering and delivery standards across regions

Infrastructure & Site Operations: Own IDC site health and Liaison with CISO to drive infrastructure stability, patching, access management, security controls, and operational readiness in close partnership with Fortive shared services (FISS)

Vendor & Partner Management: Own delivery accountability for strategic vendor and partner relationships to enforce SLAs, quality thresholds, cost discipline, and drive corrective actions where expectations are not met

Capacity & Portfolio Management: Manage run vs. grow capacity across IDC teams, align workforce plans to enterprise portfolio priorities, and ensure IDC delivery capacity is visible, planned, and optimized

Operational Rigor & Standard Work: Establish and enforce standard work for delivery planning, execution, escalation, and reporting to drive consistent cadence reviews, delivery metrics, and executive visibility

Continuous Improvement: Champion ongoing improvements in delivery productivity, quality, and cost efficiency to identify systemic issues, drive root cause resolution, and enable scalable operating practices

KPI Achievement: Define and drive key performance indicators including on-time delivery (≥90%), run/grow ratio (target 60/40), defect escape rate, infrastructure availability (≥95%), cost per unit of delivery, and team engagement

 

What Success Looks Like in Year 1

  • IDC has a clear identity as Fluke's global delivery engine — not a staff augmentation center
  • Every delivery track has named ownership, KPIs, and a cadence
  • Cross-regional delivery with China and EMEA is predictable and friction-free
  • Vendor performance is measured, managed, and improved
  • The team feels led, developed, and invested in
  • IDC budget is transparent, tracked, and optimized
  • Hiring pipeline is active and closing critical skill gaps

 

Qualifications

Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field; advanced degree preferred.

Experience: Minimum of 15+ years in technology delivery leadership, with at least 5 years leading multi-function global delivery centers. Experience managing large, diverse teams (25+ direct reports) across ERP, CRM, Web, BI, AI, Infrastructure, and Security.

Skills: Strong understanding of enterprise delivery models, vendor management, capacity planning, portfolio governance, and cross-regional operations.

Leadership: Proven ability to build high-performing teams, drive accountability, and operate at both strategic and execution levels.

Communication: Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to engage senior leadership, cross-functional partners, and individual contributors equally.

Certifications: Experience with FBS, Lean, Agile, SAFe, or similar continuous improvement frameworks is a plus.

Other Information

This position will report directly to the Chief Information Officer (CIO) and is based at Fluke's India Development Center in Bangalore. The Director will work closely with US-based vertical and horizontal leaders, the CISO, EA/PMO/LPM, Fortive shared services, and China and EMEA site leads. Occasional travel required to Fluke headquarters (Everett, WA), EMEA, and China locations.

title: Data Engineer - Azure
jobDescription:
Job Summary: 

We are seeking a skilled Data Engineer with strong expertise in the Microsoft Azure ecosystem. The ideal candidate will design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines and data solutions that support business analytics, reporting, and advanced data use cases. This role requires hands-on experience with Azure data services, data modeling, and ETL/ELT processes.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain data pipelines for ingesting, transforming, and loading data from various sources.
  • Build and optimize ETL/ELT workflows using Azure-native tools.
  • Work with structured and unstructured data across multiple platforms.
  • Ensure data quality, integrity, and accuracy through validation and monitoring.
  • Implement data modeling solutions for analytics and reporting.
  • Collaborate with business analysts, data scientists, and stakeholders to understand data requirements.
  • Optimize performance and scalability of data pipelines and storage.
  • Ensure data governance, security, and compliance standards are met.
  • Troubleshoot data issues and provide solutions proactively.

Required Skills & Experience

Core Azure Services

  • Azure Data Factory (ADF) – data integration and orchestration
  • Azure SQL / Azure SQL Database
  • Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2
  • Azure Databricks (PySpark / Spark SQL)

Programming & Querying

  • Strong SQL skills 
  • Python (for data processing and automation)
  • PySpark / Spark (for big data processing)

Data Engineering Concepts

  • ETL/ELT design patterns
  • Data warehousing concepts (Star/Snowflake schema)
  • Incremental loads and CDC (Change Data Capture)
  • Data modeling (dimensional & normalized models)

DevOps & Automation

  • Azure DevOps / CI-CD pipelines
  • Git version control

Additional / Preferred Skills

  • Experience with Power BI for data visualization integration
  • Knowledge of data governance tools (e.g., Purview)
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field
  • 2-4 years of experience in data engineering or related role
  • Hands-on experience with Azure data platform is required

Key Competencies

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to work with large datasets efficiently
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills
  • Attention to detail and data quality focus

Nice-to-Have Certifications

  • Microsoft Certified: Azure Data Engineer Associate (DP-203)
  • Azure Fundamentals (AZ-900)

Fortive 9 Behaviors by Level: 

Influencing & Mentoring

Customer Obsessed: Champions a customer-focusedculture by anticipating evolving needs and shaping solutions that deliver long-term value.

Strategic: Drives organizational impact by using data to derive insights that inform near-term and mid-range goals

Innovation for Impact: Influences innovation through demonstrating bold thinking and experimentation in own work and coaching others to do the same. 

Inspiring: Demonstrates purpose-driven impact through expertise and collaboration.

Builds Extraordinary Teams: Drives impact through collaboration and influence by fostering trust, sharing expertise, and aligning efforts across teams.

Courageous: Influences and leads by example through action and integrity—moves quickly toward goals, tackles challenges head-on, and encourages open sharing of ideas without fear.

Delivers Results: Leads complex initiatives to successful completion with high standards, precision, and urgency.

Adaptable: Applies rigor and stays true to process while fostering adaptability within the team.

Lead with FBS: Embraces FBS and models lean principles by mentoring peers and influencing teams, and going to Gemba for first-hand insights.

title: Information Security Compliance Analyst
jobDescription:
Description

We're looking for an Information Security Compliance Analyst to join our Information Security GRC team. This role supports compliance programs across a global organization, spanning multiple regulatory frameworks, security certifications, and risk management initiatives. You'll also contribute to broader GRC efforts, including third-party risk management, risk profile reporting, policy governance, and security compliance.

Reporting to the Senior Information Security Compliance Lead, you'll work across IT, Finance, Legal, and Quality teams to ensure controls are operating effectively, audit evidence is delivered on time, and compliance obligations are met. This is a great fit for someone who thrives in a multi-framework environment and wants to grow across the full GRC spectrum.

Responsibilities
  • Support the execution and maintenance of compliance programs across multiple frameworks, including SOX, ISO 27001, SOC 2, CMMC, NIST 800-171, Cyber Essentials, EU Regulations, and other compliance requirements.
  • Coordinate evidence collection, control testing, and audit deliverables for both internal and external audits, ensuring timely, accurate, and audit-defensible responses.
  • Work with control owners across IT, Finance, and business teams to ensure controls are performed on schedule and documentation meets quality standards.
  • Contribute to the organization's risk profile, helping track, report, and improve security and compliance metrics.
  • Support third-party risk management activities, including vendor security assessments and risk acceptance workflows.
  • Assist in maintaining and operating the organization's GRC platform for controls management, risk assessments, and policy exceptions.
  • Conduct periodic reviews of compliance controls, processes, and procedures to identify gaps and drive continuous improvement.
  • Provide guidance and support to control owners on evidence requirements, control design, and audit readiness.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure compliance programs are integrated and aligned with business objectives.
  • Stay current on regulatory changes, industry standards, and evolving compliance requirements to keep programs effective.
Qualifications

Required

  • 2+ years of experience in a compliance, GRC, or IT audit role.
  • Working knowledge of SOX ITGC/ITAC controls and the audit lifecycle.
  • Familiarity with at least two of the following: ISO 27001, SOC 2, NIST 800-171, CMMC, Cyber Essentials.
  • Strong organizational skills, ability to manage multiple audit timelines, deliverables, and stakeholders simultaneously.
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills; able to translate compliance requirements for technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Self-starter with a continuous improvement mindset.

Preferred

  • Experience with GRC platforms (e.g., LogicGate, ServiceNow GRC, AuditBoard, or similar).
  • Exposure to cloud security compliance (AWS, Azure) or vulnerability management programs.
  • Experience supporting external audits.
  • Familiarity with third-party risk management processes.
  • Relevant certifications (CISA, CRISC, ISO 27001 Lead Auditor, Security+, or similar) are a plus but not required.

title: Training Manager - Technical
jobDescription:
Job Description: Technical Training Manager

Position Overview

We are seeking a highly skilled Technical Training Manager to design, develop, and deliver training programs for our associates, partners, and customers. This role is critical in ensuring that our workforce and external stakeholders are equipped with the technical knowledge and practical skills required to maximize the value of our test and measurement solutions. The ideal candidate will combine industrial technical expertise with strong instructional design and facilitation skills.

 

Key Responsibilities

Training Program Development

  • Design and develop comprehensive training modules covering product features and applications
  • Create blended learning content (classroom, e-learning, hands-on labs, webinars).
  • Regularly update training materials to reflect new product releases and industry standards.

Training Delivery

  • Plan, schedule, and execute internal training sessions for employees across departments.
  • Conduct external training programs for partners, distributors, and customers nationally.
  • Deliver training in multiple formats: workshops, seminars, online courses, and certification programs.

Stakeholder Engagement

  • Collaborate with product managers, Engineering teams, and sales engineers to ensure training content is technically accurate and aligned with business goals.
  • Partner with regional offices to adapt training programs to local market needs.
  • Collect feedback from trainees and stakeholders to continuously improve training effectiveness.

Knowledge Management

  • Develop and maintain a centralized training repository (manuals, videos, FAQs, case studies).
  • Implement learning management systems (LMS) for tracking participation and performance.
  • Ensure compliance with industry standards and safety regulations in training content.

 

Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in electrical/ Electronic Engineering, Instrumentation, or related field or master’s degree in physics, Electronics. 
  • Minimum 10 years of experience in technical training, product support, or application engineering.
  • Proven expertise in test and measurement equipment (oscilloscopes, analysers, imagers, meters, sensors, etc.).
  • Strong knowledge of instructional design methodologies and experience with LMS platforms and e-learning authoring tools.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and facilitation skills.
  • Ability to work in a multicultural, global environment and travel internationally.
  • Core industrial or teaching experience is an added advantage. 

 

Key Competencies

  • Technical Depth: Strong understanding of test and measurement technologies.
  • Instructional Design: Ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear, engaging training content.
  • Leadership: Capable of managing training projects end-to-end and mentoring junior trainers.
  • Collaboration: Skilled at working cross-functionally with engineering, sales, and customer support teams.
  • Customer Orientation: Focused on delivering value to partners and customers through effective training.

 

Travel Requirement: 40%

jobDescription:

We are seeking a skilled Data Engineer with strong expertise in the Microsoft Azure ecosystem. The ideal candidate will design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines and data solutions that support business analytics, reporting, and advanced data use cases. This role requires hands-on experience with Azure data services, data modeling, and ETL/ELT processes.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain data pipelines for ingesting, transforming, and loading data from various sources.
  • Build and optimize ETL/ELT workflows using Azure-native tools.
  • Work with structured and unstructured data across multiple platforms.
  • Ensure data quality, integrity, and accuracy through validation and monitoring.
  • Implement data modeling solutions for analytics and reporting.
  • Collaborate with business analysts, data scientists, and stakeholders to understand data requirements.
  • Optimize performance and scalability of data pipelines and storage.
  • Ensure data governance, security, and compliance standards are met.
  • Troubleshoot data issues and provide solutions proactively.

Programming & Querying

Data Engineering Concepts

  • Data warehousing concepts (Star/Snowflake schema)

Additional / Preferred Skills

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to work with large datasets efficiently

title: Senior Condition-based Maintenance Engineer
jobDescription:
We are currently hiring for staffed Vibration Analysts (ISO Cat II-III certified) position for Bangalore Division.  The Vibration Analysts will work directly with their customers in the performance of their primary job responsibilities.  As an ISO Certified Category II/III, this position is expected to have a knowledge of rotating equipment; characteristics and causes of machinery vibration; be capable of monitoring/reporting; be able to perform basic fault diagnosis and condition evaluation.

Responsibilities

  • Provide Advanced Vibration Analysis remotely by working with our internal diagnostic software
  • Timely reporting of vibration analysis findings and recommendations to customer's
  • Provide troubleshooting support
    • Solve equipment problems by evaluating vibration spectrum and time waveform.
    • Seek the best technical solution by interfacing with other technical resources
  • Provide support in maintaining the vibration databases
  • Work with plant personnel to support their development of equipment maintenance strategies related to vibration analysis monitoring
  • Provide call out coverage (remote) whenever required
  • Assist with failure analysis of rotating equipment to determine root causes of failure and help determine solutions to prevent recurrence
  • Provide oversight and mentoring to less experienced Vibration Technicians

Qualifications Required

Minimum of a High School Diploma / Degree equivalent

4 or more years vibration discipline experience in solving machine problems using vibration analysis

ISO Category II / III Certification from an Accredited Certification Provider (Vibration Institute, Mobius, Technical Associates, etc.)

Strong mechanical aptitude and experience working around rotating equipment

Able to work overtime as needed, including weekends / holidays

Ability to travel as required
